data_contract: Original seed retained; append unadjusted Yahoo Daily OHLCV. Completed at NY 16:15 conservatively even on early-close days. Naive or America/New_York midnight session labels only. Changed/missing previously observed validation bars fail closed.
execution_contract: All streams start flat at cutoff; one position per symbol/arm; baseline broad production Long stream; separate pure module references and exact frozen shadows. No portfolio or live orders. Existing engines replay only persisted eligible signals. Open positions are observed-prefix censored, updated in new artifacts.
historical_context: results/strategy_improvement/SI-V1-20260930/STRATEGY_IMPROVEMENT_MATRIX_V1.md; already-used history; never pooled with validation

metrics.costs: return debit = (commission+slippage)/10000 * (1+exit_price/entry_price); one share equivalent, entry-notional denominator; no fill modification
metrics.denominator: closed finite trades only; exact zeros remain in WR denominator
metrics.excursions: existing lifecycle exact estimates and lower/upper bounds; exact denominators
metrics.groups: evidence class / arm / cost; separate symbol and exact module mask distributions
metrics.promotion: none; no retuning, automatic acceptance or pooled portfolio inference
metrics.sample: LOW SAMPLE if fewer than 100 closed trades; otherwise DESCRIPTIVE ONLY
metrics.tail: mean of worst ceil(0.05*N) closed returns, minimum one if N>0
metrics.top_winners: top 1/3/5 positive returns share of positive sum and expectancy after deletion

monitoring: Gross/net metrics by signal evidence class, arm and cost. No pooling or promotion. Review after >=100 closed trades per arm/class; low sample stays low sample. No parameter changes or ML from this protocol.
population_contract: Signal availability before freeze is TEMPORAL_OOS_LATER_UNSEEN. PROSPECTIVE_PAPER requires scan-mode persisted observation after freeze on a session date strictly after the freeze's NY date and before next calendar day 09:30 NY; missed bars are excluded backfill. Eligibility is frozen at first observation, never upgraded on rerun.

shadow_candidates.evidence: Entry V1 fixed 10-bar hypothesis REPLICATED; experimental strict sole blocker, not a Pure activation

storage.cache: Mutable open trades/cursors/latest pointer; reconstruct from seed and events
storage.decision_scope: All 191 production diagnostics once per symbol/new bar; arm signals separate

events.ENTRY_FILLED: Entry fields only, available at entry bar open
events.EXECUTION_BAR: Unchanged engine stop trace, observed at completed bar
events.EXIT_FILLED: Closed lifecycle/accounting record; open or completed-bar availability

storage.idempotency: No newly observed bars => no new event partition
storage.partition: NY invocation date / monotonically increasing run sequence
storage.pending: One atomic checksummed JSON checkpoint; completed symbols reused on resume
storage.primary: Verified freeze + original seed + immutable linked event partitions
storage.publication: All symbols required; atomic directory rename; sequence/hash chain
storage.replay: V1 _symbol in temporary scratch; full replay CPU retained, snapshots discarded
storage.state: Survived-close causal_path rows once per trade/bar; no future labels
